system.description:
STUPIDITY At the start of an encounter, place a token for each giant or troll present on 8 of the Stupidity tracker. At the start of each of its turns, advance that creature's token 1 space. When its token reaches a dark blue event space, the GM rolls {Dc}.

Players are encouraged to seize a bout of stupidity for a humorous purpose: a giant might decide to pick its nose—only to pull out a dead bird—or perhaps it snatches up a nearby animal and stuffs the hapless creature into its pants. Trolls are prone to beat up allies or stop fighting altogether in order to eat. This is typical of these brutes. While the players may be terrified of these creatures, the players don’t have to be. If the result is 3, the creature loses focus and ignores the player characters until its turn. On any other result, the creature acts normally.
